question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：伊拉克 vs 挪威（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group I: Iraq vs Norway (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 挪威凭哈兰德火力与 307 分 Elo 差距占约三分之二胜算，但伊拉克刚逼平西班牙，低位防守让平局有现实可能。
one_liner_en: Norway are ~two-thirds favourites on Haaland's firepower and a 307-point Elo gap, but Iraq just held Spain and their low block gives the draw real upside.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 307 分（挪威 1914 vs 伊拉克 1607），Davidson 模型基线给挪威约 68.5% 胜算。
key_reasons.en: 307-point Elo gap (Norway 1914 vs Iraq 1607); the Davidson baseline gives Norway ~68.5%.

key_reasons.cn: 哈兰德欧洲区预选赛 16 球、46 场 50 个国家队进球史上最快，挪威攻击力顶级。
key_reasons.en: Haaland scored 16 in European qualifying and reached 50 international goals in a record 46 caps — elite firepower.

key_reasons.cn: 伊拉克 6 月 4 日 1-1 逼平 Elo 第 1 的西班牙，低位防守体系成色十足，支撑小幅上调平局与冷门概率。
key_reasons.en: Iraq held Elo #1 Spain 1-1 on Jun 4, validating their low block and a small upward shift for the draw/upset.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) p_stat 11.7/19.8/68.5 + bounded evidence adjustment (+1.3/+1.2/-2.5 pp, cap ±8pp), renormalized. No market inputs of any kind.
